Name: Insurance Scheme
Description: The insurance scheme the patient is using to settle payment for services, expects a uuid

Name: Payment Method
Description: The payment method used by the patient to settle payment, expects a uuid

Name: Patient Type
Description: If the patient will be paying or receives services for free, expects a uuid

Name: Visit Queue Number
Description: The visit queue number used to identify patients on the queue screen

Name: HFR Facility ID
Description: ABDM Health Facility Registry ID for this location - used as the X-HIP-ID header. Scoped per Location so one install can serve several facilities under a single HRP credential. Sandbox test facility: IN020002510.

Name: Patient Category
Description: Fee-eligibility category applying to THIS visit (D11) - General, BPL/subsidised, staff, scheme-linked, exempt. Concept-coded against set 7486228b-2618-4708-97a1-9779191884cb. Pre-filled from the patient's most recent visit so the clerk usually accepts it with one keystroke; a change on a later visit never restates a past bill. SINGLE QUESTION (D16, 2026-08-05): every category belongs to exactly one side of paying/non-paying, so payability is DERIVED from the category rather than asked separately - Billing maps each category to payable or exempt in its own configuration. The clerk answers one question, and one visit_attribute row is the single source of truth for pricing. BOUNDARY: distinct from the stock 'Patient Type' visit attribute (fbc0702d), the billing module's own paying/free flag, which stays under its control - we never set it. Written by BOTH entry points: the HISP India registration page and the stock dashboard visit form, which is configured to render this same attribute type.

Name: Counter Code
Description: Short admin-chosen code identifying this physical counter/kiosk to ABDM's Scan and Share flow. Typed into the ABDM/HFR portal's counter-id field when generating that counter's static QR, and echoed back in the inbound webhook's metaData.context so this counter's queue can be resolved. Keep it short and plain alphanumeric -- the ABDM portal strips hyphens and truncates long values before embedding them in the QR, so anything longer or punctuated (e.g. a Location uuid) comes back corrupted and unresolvable. Set independently per counter Location -- deliberately not inherited from a parent, unlike HFR Facility ID.
